# Nerve Alive (nervealive.onrender.com)

> Independent information and ordering website for Nerve Alive, a herbal dietary supplement capsule for adult men (60 capsules per bottle) offered to support energy, stamina and everyday vitality.

## Key facts
- Named ingredients: Benfotiamine, Methylcobalamin, Alpha-Lipoic Acid, Acetyl-L-Carnitine, Magnesium Glycinate, Turmeric, Capsaicin, Passionflower, Feverfew (amounts are on the bottle panel)
- Directions: two capsules daily with water, preferably with a meal
- Packs (USD): 2 bottles $69 each ($138 plus shipping); 3 bottles $59 each ($177 plus shipping); 6 bottles $49 each ($294, free US shipping); two bonus eBooks listed with the 6-bottle pack
- One-time purchase; 60-day money-back guarantee, subject to the terms shown at checkout
- Not a treatment for neuropathy, diabetes or any condition; adults only; tingling or numbness needs a doctor first; ask a doctor if taking diabetes, blood-thinning, thyroid, seizure or sedative medicine
